newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SOCCER-ROMANIA WIN AGAIN TO MAINTAIN 100 PER CENT RECORD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMANIA WIN AGAIN TO MAINTAIN 100 PER CENT RECORD.

text.p: Romania stayed on course for an automatic place in next year's World Cup finals when they beat Lithuania 1-0 on Wednesday to maintain their 100 per cent record at the top of qualifying group eight.
The only goal of a hard-fought match came 15 minutes from time when Dino Moldovan scored to give his team their fifth successive victory in the group and take their goal tally to 19-0.
Romania, who beat Liechtenstein 8-0 on Saturday, had a much harder battle against a far from overawed home side who could have moved into third place if they had won.
Romania looked to have gone ahead after 64 minutes but a scrambled goal was disallowed for a foul on the keeper.
They finally made their breakthrough in the 75th minute when Moldovan scored with a close-range effort.
Instead of sitting on their lead, Romania went looking for more goals and substiture Adrian Ilie was twice denied at point-blank range by Lithuanian goalkeeper Gintaras Stauce.
